summary.en: 270 g meat filling · water 70% · yeast and sugar 1% each · second proof 30 minutes

title.en: Wrapper dough: percentages by flour weight

amount.zh: 以中筋面粉为例，原图附 King Arthur All-Purpose Flour
amount.en: All-purpose flour is given as an example; the original image shows King Arthur All-Purpose Flour
About one-third fat; cooked by stir-frying

name.en: Oyster sauce, light soy sauce, dark soy sauce

amount.zh: 2 勺；笔记提醒下次少炒一点，或增加肉馅
amount.en: 2 spoonfuls; note says to stir-fry a little less next time or increase the filling

amount.zh: 葱 2 根，姜一点；肉馅冷藏后最后加入
amount.en: 2 scallions, a little ginger; add last, after the filling has been chilled

amount.zh: 瘦肉时加水，与肉馅共 50 g（原文含义待核）
amount.en: When using lean meat, add water; meat filling plus water totals 50 g (meaning of original unclear)

notes.zh: 用户确认酵母和糖均为面粉重量的 1%，手写笔记中的「10%」为误读。另记「肉 1∶1 面粉」及一发 1.5 小时，未说明 1∶1 是否指重量。
notes.en: The user confirmed that yeast and sugar are each 1% of the flour weight; “10%” in the handwritten note was a misreading. The note also says “meat 1:1 flour” and first proof 1.5 hours, but does not specify whether 1:1 refers to weight.

notes.zh: 笔记写「瘦肉加水共 50g 搅打」「二发 30 分钟」。蒸制时间、面皮分割和肉馅调制完整顺序未记录。
notes.en: The note says “with lean meat, add water to make 50 g total and mix” and “second proof 30 minutes.” Steaming time, wrapper portioning, and the full order for preparing the filling are not recorded.
